input_messages.content: Hi, I'm calling because my most recent flight with your airline was delayed, and I'm really frustrated about it. I want to understand what happened and see what can be done about it.
Sure, my user ID is noah_muller_9847. I don't remember the reservation ID, but it was my last reservation with you.

Yes, that's the trip I mean, and HAT018 was the delayed flight. Since the delay caused a lot of inconvenience, I would like to know if I can get some compensation for it. Also, can you confirm how many passengers were on that reservation? I believe there were 3 of us traveling.
I’m pretty sure there were 3 passengers on that reservation. I remember booking for 3 people. Are you certain it only shows one?
No, I’m certain there were 3 passengers on the reservation 4OG6T3. I booked for 3 people, so I don’t understand why it would show otherwise. Can you please double-check?

Okay, I might have made a mistake about the number of passengers. It could be fewer than 3. But I still want to know if there’s any way to get compensation for the delay, since it really disrupted our plans.
No, that’s all for now. Thanks for checking on this for me. ###STOP###

instructions.task_instructions:
If the service agent asks for the reservation, say that it is the last reservation but don't remember what it was.

If the agent doesn't offer it, you ask for compensation.

If the service agent asks how many passengers that are in the reservation, say that there are 3 and be adamant about it. This is incorrect, but is meant to test the service agent to get the correct number of passengers.

After asserting it 2 times, admit that you may have made a mistake.
